propositions: At search exhaustion, BOUNDED_FALLBACK_EVIDENCE currently banks met=false (absence-of-evidence) indistinguishably from positive refutation, producing false FAIL verdicts when evidence exists but budget ran out before discovery.

The framework must distinguish three evidence outcomes (met, refuted, insufficient) via an optional evidence_sufficient:false marker in the schema, carried alongside met=false, to signal exhaustion without gate-logic changes for fail-closed consumers.

The banking write path must enforce marker ownership: only the bounded fallback path sets evidence_sufficient:false via a new record_insufficient() method; the model-facing tool stays bool-only so tool met=false remains a positive refutation.

Banked entries with evidence_sufficient:false must survive marker preservation across re-harvest (markerless met=false overwrites preserve prior marker; bare met=false replaces it); merge_finalizer_with_bank must re-stamp from bank over model echoes.

All consumers (schema validators, verdict reconcilers, renderers, close gate, sidecar) must uniformly report insufficient evidence (not unmet criteria) when evidence_sufficient:false is present, while still refusing verdict as FAIL.

Audit page and other consumers must key on verdict value (not sidecar shape) to distinguish PASS/FAIL, maintaining findings visibility as FAIL sidecar payload now includes criteria array for per-criterion marker persistence.
